data.title: Getting a paper accepted
data.author: stefanpie
data.article_summary: 本文介绍了如何通过优化论文的首页元素来提高论文的接收概率。作者以自己2019年一篇论文为例，该论文最初被拒，但在一周后稍作修改即被接受，评分从2.5、3、3提升到4、4.5、4.5。文章强调，论文首页的标题、摘要、图1和引言是决定评审第一印象的关键，这四部分应做到具体、易记、清晰并传达价值。具体策略包括：选择独特且具象的标题、适当添加品牌化名称、确保图1直观展示研究价值。此外，论文其余部分需进行充分验证，包括基线对比、消融实验、统计显著性和人工评估等，以避免被拒。作者指出，这些修改不仅提升了论文的接收机会，也改善了科学贡献质量。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：学术论文发表过程中的社会性、沟通技巧以及科学性之间的平衡

不同观点：
• abetusk认为学术科学已经演变成一种职业生涯的社交游戏，论文逐渐成为一种广告和品牌营销工具，而非单纯为了分享新发现。这种现象在学术界越来越普遍，尽管有些建议是有价值的，但整体趋势令人担忧。
• eeeeeehio指出，学术界过于关注“想法”，但如今想法很廉价，研究的核心在于实验的执行和结果的如实报告，而不仅仅是清晰沟通。科学不应只停留在沟通想法的层面，还需要严谨的实验验证。
• techas从自身经验出发，补充了“作者工程”的概念，指出进入新领域时，如果作者不为编辑所熟知，论文容易被拒。PhD学生因有导师背书较少遇到这种情况，建议通过合作或社交增加知名度。
• jampa认为文章中关于“为什么”比“什么”更重要的观点不仅适用于论文写作，也适用于开源书籍和代码注释，强调动机和背景的重要性。
• stefanpie分享了个人经历，指出论文的反复修改和被拒并不一定意味着质量问题，有时是因为不符合特定评审的口味，建议根据会议风格调整投稿策略，但也呼吁评审方提高评审质量。

补充讨论：
• 3abiton质疑如何证明修改后的论文确实更好，指出评审过程主观性强，单一样本无法证明因果关系。
• canjobear认为论文被接受与否可能与评审者的随机喜好有关，修改未必是决定因素，建议对评审意见保持平常心。
• speedgoose建议先投高质量期刊，若被拒则根据合理意见改进再投其他地方。
• whatshisface提到在机器学习领域，某些基准测试或案例只有当多数模型表现良好时才会被接受，暗示学术评审有时受主观影响。
• JR1427用“人靠衣装，论文靠版面”来形容，认为漂亮的排版和清晰的表达有助于论文被更好理解和接受。
• ubj指出不同领域要求不同，如控制理论期刊更看重新颖的定理和严谨的数学证明。
• fl4tul4引用了一句无名氏的话：“玩转学术游戏不是科学。”暗示学术界存在功利性倾向。

争议焦点：学术论文的核心价值是想法的创新和清晰沟通，还是实验的严谨性和结果的真实性。不同学者对评审过程的主观性和论文修改的有效性也存在分歧。

44057841.article_content:
Contents
Apr 10, 2025
The PhD Metagame
How to Get Your Paper Accepted
Page 1 Accepts, the Rest Avoids Reject
In 2019, I submitted a paper that was rejected with review scores 2.5, 3, 3. One week later, I resubmitted it with minor changes, and it was accepted with scores 4, 4.5, 4.5.
01
For context, that’s an almost unspeakably dramatic jump in scores, from “middling reject” to “strong accept.”
This post shows exactly those changes. We’ll frame them in two parts:
Polish page 1 for acceptance
Use the remaining pages to avoid rejection
Page 1 has four parts: title, abstract, Figure 1, and introduction. We’ll make them specific, memorable, clear, communicate value, and hook the reader. Reviewers mostly decide accept vs reject by page 1. So we optimize the judgment-before-scroll.
Then, to make sure our paper isn’t rejected, we’ll do due diligence in the rest of it by including stuff like baselines, ablations, statistical significance, and human evaluation.
The tweaks that get the paper accepted—unexpectedly, happily—also improve the actual science contribution. But if you’re tempted to be evil, read this footnote.
02
The full rejected and accepted submissions are available for download at the end.
Page 1 Is 80% of Your Paper
#
A paper has five parts:
Title
Figure 1
Abstract
Introduction
Rest of the paper
Spend equal time on each of these.
—
Me misquoting
03
Jitendra Malik quoting Don Geman
Around 80% of a paper’s perceived quality is established on page 1. The title, Figure 1, abstract, and half the introduction are all there. It’s like a book’s cover.
Throughout this post, I’ll show the rejected and accepted versions of the paper I mentioned at the top with the dramatic score swing. Here are both page 1s:
Top:
Left:
Rejected page 1.
Bottom:
Right:
Accepted page 1.
First, consider page 1’s first impression:
04
Is the Figure 1 colorful and eye-catching?
Is the title unexpected? Maybe it has one intriguing word?
Are there any curious terms (bolded or italicized)?
Is the introduction (hopefully not) full of citations?
05
Choose A Specific Memorable Title
#
Rejected:
Visually Grounded Comparative Language Generation
— too general. Any work that uses pictures and generates comparisons could use this title. I picked this title because I thought it argued for the generality of the method. But a too-general title is off-putting because it comes across as over-claiming. And a big part of our method
does
rely on our domain: we specifically use a biological taxonomy to create our dataset.
Accepted:
Neural Naturalist: Generating Fine-grained Image Comparisons
— specific and memorable. In addition to branding (more next),
naturalist
establishes the domain, and
fine-grained
narrows the task. Skeptical academics appreciate the clarity of saying what you did. The title is fully unique to our work.
06
Maybe Add Branding
#
I used to dislike branding in papers. It felt presumptuous to claim a proper noun for your research paper and to expect readers to memorize it. And many of the names sound corny.
Now, while I still often feel a pang of annoyance, it is outweighed by the recognition that it’s much easier to remember and discuss concepts which have a name.
Neural naturalist
or
Birds-to-Words
instead of “our 2019 EMNLP paper about generating comparative image captions…”
That said, I still dislike throwaway names—those with no conceptual link, or which don’t feel earned. I don’t think every paper needs one. But I think it helped for this paper.
Show Screamingly Obvious Value in Figure 1
#
The main point is that your paper’s value should be
obvious,
not that is must be
enormous.
Top:
Left:
Rejected Figure 1.
Bottom:
Right:
Accepted Figure 1.
A Figure 1 should
draw readers in
clearly demonstrate describe both what the work does and its value
be comprehensible without the caption.
The old Figure 1 showed two separate comparisons, but the link between them wasn’t clear. The bottom row just all look like owls to a non-expert. And the descriptions are long and boring.
The new Figure 1 makes the works’ focus explicit by anchoring with the same left image, and labeling each comparison with a perceptual difficulty (“high” vs “medium”). It annotates the operation (“vs” = comparison) and the result (“highly detailed” vs “fewer details”). At this point, the paper’s mechanics and unique characteristic has been established: we use different language to compare things based on how similar they look. Finally, to make the long descriptions more approachable and interesting, we’ve highlighted two components (features and parts, with orange underlines and green bubbles).

44057841.article_summary: 本文介绍了如何通过优化论文的首页元素来提高论文的接收概率。作者以自己2019年一篇论文为例，该论文最初被拒，但在一周后稍作修改即被接受，评分从2.5、3、3提升到4、4.5、4.5。文章强调，论文首页的标题、摘要、图1和引言是决定评审第一印象的关键，这四部分应做到具体、易记、清晰并传达价值。具体策略包括：选择独特且具象的标题、适当添加品牌化名称、确保图1直观展示研究价值。此外，论文其余部分需进行充分验证，包括基线对比、消融实验、统计显著性和人工评估等，以避免被拒。作者指出，这些修改不仅提升了论文的接收机会，也改善了科学贡献质量。

主要讨论点：学术论文发表过程中的社会性、沟通技巧以及科学性之间的平衡

• techas从自身经验出发，补充了“作者工程”的概念，指出进入新领域时，如果作者不为编辑所熟知，论文容易被拒。PhD学生因有导师背书较少遇到这种情况，建议通过合作或社交增加知名度。
• jampa认为文章中关于“为什么”比“什么”更重要的观点不仅适用于论文写作，也适用于开源书籍和代码注释，强调动机和背景的重要性。
• stefanpie分享了个人经历，指出论文的反复修改和被拒并不一定意味着质量问题，有时是因为不符合特定评审的口味，建议根据会议风格调整投稿策略，但也呼吁评审方提高评审质量。

• canjobear认为论文被接受与否可能与评审者的随机喜好有关，修改未必是决定因素，建议对评审意见保持平常心。
• speedgoose建议先投高质量期刊，若被拒则根据合理意见改进再投其他地方。
• whatshisface提到在机器学习领域，某些基准测试或案例只有当多数模型表现良好时才会被接受，暗示学术评审有时受主观影响。
• JR1427用“人靠衣装，论文靠版面”来形容，认为漂亮的排版和清晰的表达有助于论文被更好理解和接受。
• ubj指出不同领域要求不同，如控制理论期刊更看重新颖的定理和严谨的数学证明。
• fl4tul4引用了一句无名氏的话：“玩转学术游戏不是科学。”暗示学术界存在功利性倾向。

争议焦点：学术论文的核心价值是想法的创新和清晰沟通，还是实验的严谨性和结果的真实性。不同学者对评审过程的主观性和论文修改的有效性也存在分歧。

data.author: cebert
data.article_summary: 本文是一位创意专业人士对生成式AI影响的个人反思。作者既表达了对AI的喜爱，也透露了对它取代自己部分工作的无奈。作者自2018年起从事插画副业，但过去12个月收入下降超过50%。虽然AI工具提升了创作效率和创意，但也取代了许多传统创意技能。作者承认，历史上不乏因创新而失传的技艺，而人类总会找到新的创造方式。最终，作者对AI持复杂态度：既感激其带来的便利，又惋惜某些技能可能因此消失。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：AI技术对艺术和音乐行业的影响，以及对艺术家和创意工作的挑战

不同观点：
• **[strogonoff]** 认为，机器学习（ML）在音乐领域的应用导致了公司面临巨额诉讼，而在图形和文本领域却无人关注类似问题。这让人感觉大科技公司可以无视法律，除非有另一个大公司站出来反对。同时，普通人很难从中受益。

• **[Nition]** 关注寻找专业艺术家进行委托创作的困难。他提到目前没有专门的网站用于雇佣艺术家，现有的平台如ArtStation、Fiverr和Reddit都不能很好地满足高质量艺术委托的需求，且受到AI生成艺术的干扰。他质疑那些建议雇佣真人艺术家的人，究竟到哪里去找这些艺术家。

• **[Waterluvian]** 认为，创意的表达会随着时间演变，且难以从内部评估。他以自己孩子使用Scratch制作动画为例，说明创意的渴望是无法抑制的，并将继续以新的形式存在。他似乎对AI的影响持较为乐观的态度。

• **[Papazsazsa]** 强调，职业在面对竞争时会消亡，这不是新鲜事。更危险的是，互联网正在从学习与分享的资源转变为一个难以获取知识的场所。他对未来的互联网持悲观态度，并隐含对奢侈品消费的批评。

• **[__loam]** 认为，AI对艺术行业的影响被夸大，市场变化更多是由于经济和行业自身调整。他提到游戏行业在疫情期间的不正常增长和随后的回调，以及市场预算削减等因素。他还指出使用AI的声誉风险，尤其是在游戏等艺术作品中，AI生成内容被视为低质量的标志。

• **[ivape]** 对AI的影响持悲观态度，认为AI将导致设计工作的终结，尤其是通过竞标工作和免费生成内容。他还提出一个激进的观点，认为只有世界大战才能重置现状，并提到AI可能被用于煽动冲突。

• **[sheepscreek]** 简短总结了对AI技术的态度：喜欢这项技术，但不喜欢因此失去生意。

• **[sneak]** 认为，AI并不是导致艺术家失去工作的根本原因，根本原因是低努力任务的商品化。他提到，即使没有AI，低收入国家的廉价劳动力也能以低价竞争。

补充讨论：
• AI技术在不同创意领域（如音乐、图形、文本）的法律与市场反应差异。
• 寻找高质量艺术家的实际困难以及现有平台的不足。
• 创意工作的演变与人类创意的不可抑制性。
• 互联网作为知识资源的角色变化。
• AI生成内容的质量问题及其对职业和市场的实际影响。
• AI对社会稳定和国际关系的潜在影响。

争议焦点：
• AI技术是否是导致艺术家失去工作的主要原因，还是其他经济和市场因素更为重要。
• AI对创意工作的长远影响是积极还是消极。
• 如何有效找到和雇佣高质量的艺术家以应对AI生成内容的竞争。

44058082.article_content:
AI Really *Is* Taking My Job
May 20, 2025
Hello, I am a creative professional.
I
create
software.
I
create
content.
I
create
illustrations.
I
create
music.
I love generative AI.
I use AI tools more and more. It's unlocked more creativity, ideas, and productivity. It helps me break loose when I get stuck. It's incredible and empowering and will only get better.
I love generative AI.
Since 2018, I've enjoyed a nice little side hustle of drawing cartoon avatars and silly illustrations for people. The illustration work never amounted to a livable income. Still, it provided a nice bonus of extra "fun" money that my family and I could use towards our hobbies and travel. Plus, it's something I really, really enjoy doing.
In the last 12 months, my illustration business has dropped more than 50%.
I hate generative AI.
It's sad, but I totally get it. Generative AI satisfies people's curiosity and provides the entertainment value that used to only come from paying an artist.
If I had access to these AI tools years ago, I may have never developed the illustration skills I have today.
I
hate
generative AI.
We will effectively lose many creative skills to a new generation without the incentive and motivation to learn them.
It isn't the first time in history we've lost amazing skills and craftsmanship to innovation. And it won't be the last.
We'll find new ways to be creative with our new tools. Things we've never done before. Things we never imagined before. We will one day think, "How did we ever live without this?"
I love generative AI.

data.title: Display any CSV file as a searchable, filterable, pretty HTML table
data.author: indigodaddy
data.article_summary:
这篇文章介绍了开源项目 "csv-to-html-table"，它可以将任何CSV文件显示为可搜索、可过滤的HTML表格，完全使用JavaScript实现。主要功能包括：

1. 克隆项目并添加CSV文件到`data/`文件夹。
2. 在`index.html`中配置选项，如CSV路径、HTML元素、是否允许下载、CSV分隔符设置及DataTables选项。
3. 支持自定义列格式化，通过自定义函数处理单元格数据。
4. 本地运行使用Python的简单HTTP服务器命令。
5. 部署到GitHub Pages或任何Web服务器。
6. 可选使用`iframe`嵌入表格到其他网站。

项目依赖Bootstrap 4、jQuery、jQuery CSV和DataTables库。文章还提供了常见问题排查方法。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：处理和展示CSV及表格数据的工具和方法

不同观点：
• waltbosz和RUnconcerned强调通过编写代码（如浏览器工具和ChatGPT生成的HTML文件）来处理表格数据，他们享受设计和拼接工具的过程，并认为这种方式比使用传统工具（如Google Sheets）更方便。
• szszrk认为PowerShell是非常高效的工具，特别是对于已经内置于工作环境中的任务（如Import-Csv和Out-GridView），尽管对PowerShell存在两极分化的看法。
• 1vuio0pswjnm7则更倾向于使用不依赖JavaScript的工具，如sqlite3和文本浏览器，以处理HTML表格。
• ederderek作为工具的创建者，欢迎其他人提交代码以移除jQuery依赖，并提到工具的旧性。
• hk1337和nashashmi希望改进工具，去除jQuery依赖或增加更多自定义格式功能，如改变颜色、宽度和添加表头包装。
• 34f34f3提出了使用Google Sheets导出HTML网页的方法，认为这样可以保留更多格式选项（如字体、颜色、边框）。
• mattsouth对csvbase.com缺乏搜索和过滤功能表示关注。
• indigodaddy结合API和Deno/deno-csv库，实现CSV文件的更新和展示，展示了系统管理员如何拼接不同工具来完成任务。
• CommenterPerson简单地表达了对工具的赞赏。
• cbeach推荐Datasette项目及其插件，认为其在处理数据提取和展示方面非常优秀。
• strunz希望工具能够直接处理管道输入的CSV数据。
• bryanhogan对工具的年龄和功能（如过滤列）提出疑问，并询问是否有其他类似工具，特别是为了处理较大的CSV文件。

补充讨论：
• 争议的焦点之一是工具的依赖性（如jQuery）和功能扩展（如自定义格式）。
• 不同用户根据自己的需求和习惯选择不同的工具和方法，如PowerShell、sqlite3、Google Sheets和Datasette等。
• 用户对工具的实用性和易用性有不同的期望和建议，特别是在处理大型CSV文件和实现更多自定义功能方面。

Clone this repository (in the command line) git clone git@github.com:derekeder/csv-to-html-table.git cd csv-to-html-table 2. Add your CSV file to the data/ folder 3. In index.html set your options in the CsvToHtmlTable.init() function < script > CsvToHtmlTable . init ( { csv_path : 'data/Health Clinics in Chicago.csv' , element : 'table-container' , allow_download : true , csv_options : { separator : ',' , delimiter : '"' } , datatables_options : { "paging" : false } } ) ; Available options csv_path Path to your CSV file. element The HTML element to render your table to. Defaults to table-container allow_download if true, shows a link to download the CSV file. Defaults to false csv_options jQuery CSV configuration. Use this if you want to use a custom delimiter or separator in your input file. See their documentation . datatables_options DataTables configuration. See their documentation . custom_formatting New! A list of column indexes and custom functions to format your data (see below) Custom formatting If you want to do custom formatting for one or more column, you can pass in an array of arrays containing the index of the column and a custom function for formatting it. You can pass in multiple formatters and they will be executed in order. The custom functions must take in one parameter (the value in the cell) and return a HTML string: Example: < script > //my custom function that creates a hyperlink function format_link ( link ) { if ( link ) return "" + link + "" ; else return "" ; } //initializing the table CsvToHtmlTable . init ( { csv_path : 'data/Health Clinics in Chicago.csv' , element : 'table-container' , allow_download : true , csv_options : { separator : ',' , delimiter : '"' } , datatables_options : { "paging" : false } , custom_formatting : [ [ 4 , format_link ] ] //execute the function on the 4th column of every row } ) ; Note that you should take care about HTML escaping to avoid XSS or broken layout. jQuery has a nice function text() which safely escapes HTML from value. 4. Run it You can run this locally using this handy python command: python -m SimpleHTTPServer ...or with Python 3: python -m http.server navigate to http://localhost:8000/ 5. Deploy it GitHub pages You can host your table on GitHub pages for free! Once you've made all your changes and committed them, push everything in the master branch to gh-pages which automatically enables GitHub pages. git push origin master:gh-pages Then navigate to http://your-github-username.github.io/csv-to-html-table/ Read more on working with GitHub pages projects . Web server This project should work on any web server. Upload this entire project (including all the css , data , fonts and js folders) to a public folder on your server using FTP. 6. iframe it (optional) Want to embed your nifty table on your website? You can use an iframe . data.title: Gemini Diffusion
data.author: mdp2021
data.article_summary: Google在I/O大会上发布了Gemini Diffusion，这是其首个使用扩散模型（而非传统的自回归方式）的大语言模型。与逐字生成文本的传统模型不同，扩散模型通过逐步优化噪声来生成输出，速度更快，并能在数学和代码编辑等任务中表现更好。作者测试时，模型以857个词元/秒的速度生成交互式网页，速度令人印象深刻。尽管尚未有独立基准测试，但Google称其性能可媲美Gemini 2.0 Flash-Lite，且速度是其5倍。扩散模型并未取代Transformer，而是替代了自回归方法。

不同观点：
• [r33b33] 关注Gemini Diffusion是否能处理大型代码库，并询问是否已有工具可以帮助他用AI代替程序员。
• [cztomsik] 认为Gemini Diffusion可能只是通过后期训练实现的，并提到RWKV团队用类似的方法取得了成功。他还讨论了注意力机制和FFN的作用，并提出是否可以通过共享固定的嵌入和注意力来加速训练。
• [airstrike] 对大型预存代码库的改进持怀疑态度，认为模型无法理解代码库中不存在的部分，因此在处理大型代码库时会受到限制。
• [shreezus] 对扩散模型在代码生成中的应用感到震惊，并期待未来在该领域看到更多进展。
• [heliophobicdude] 强调Gemini Diffusion在拼写检查、代码修改和代码编辑器中的实际应用，特别是其快速编辑功能。

补充讨论：
• [hiimshort] 讨论了扩散技术在文本生成中的潜力，并提到当前模型在大小和上下文长度上的限制，以及对低端GPU性能的担忧。
• [mountainriver] 指出扩散模型在推理和规划方面优于自回归模型，因为它可以编辑且不受早期token偏见的影响。
• [renjimen] 认为Gemini Diffusion的速度将使软件开发变得更加流畅，应用程序可以根据用户需求动态生成所需部分。
• [findingMeaning] 提到模型容易受到提示注入攻击，并指出在某些不当使用情况下的潜在风险。
• [nodja] 担心扩散目标在模型能力上会比自回归模型差，但认为如果多token自回归模型表现良好，或者可以用作推测解码的草案模型。
• [huevosabio] 对扩散语言模型的潜力感到兴奋，并希望获得API访问以应用于游戏开发。
• [benob] 猜测自回归LLM可以通过微调来进行扩散推理，并询问扩散是否有可能提高CPU推理速度。
• [seydor] 对通过去除噪声生成文本的概念感到深刻，并表示将进一步研究。
• [dr_dshiv] 关注扩散模型在思考速度和质量之间的权衡，并询问低质量思考是否会影响高质量模型输出的性能。
• [gdiamos] 询问扩散LLM推理框架在哪里可以运行这些模型。

争议焦点：
• 扩散模型在处理大型代码库时的有效性和限制。
• 扩散模型与自回归模型在推理和规划能力上的比较。
• 扩散模型在实际应用中的速度和质量之间的权衡。

这些讨论展示了Gemini Diffusion模型在不同应用场景中的潜力和挑战，以及社区对该技术未来发展的期待和担忧。

44057820.article_content:
Simon Willison’s Weblog
Subscribe
Gemini Diffusion
. Another of the announcements from Google I/O yesterday was Gemini Diffusion, Google's first LLM to use diffusion (similar to image models like Imagen and Stable Diffusion) in place of transformers.
Google describe it like this:
Traditional autoregressive language models generate text one word – or token – at a time. This sequential process can be slow, and limit the quality and coherence of the output.
Diffusion models work differently. Instead of predicting text directly, they learn to generate outputs by refining noise, step-by-step. This means they can iterate on a solution very quickly and error correct during the generation process. This helps them excel at tasks like editing, including in the context of math and code.
The key feature then is
speed
. I made it through the waitlist and tried it out just now and
wow
, they are not kidding about it being fast.
In this video I prompt it with "Build a simulated chat app" and it responds at 857 tokens/second, resulting in an interactive HTML+JavaScript page (embedded in the chat tool, Claude Artifacts style) within single digit seconds.
The performance feels similar to
the Cerebras Coder tool
, which used Cerebras to run Llama3.1-70b at around 2,000 tokens/second.
How good is the model? I've not seen any independent benchmarks yet, but Google's landing page for it promises "the performance of Gemini 2.0 Flash-Lite at 5x the speed" so presumably they think it's comparable to Gemini 2.0 Flash-Lite, one of their least expensive models.
Prior to this the only commercial grade diffusion model I've encountered is
Inception Mercury
back in February this year.
Update
: a correction from
synapsomorphy on Hacker News
:
Diffusion isn't in place of transformers, it's in place of autoregression. Prior diffusion LLMs like
Mercury
still use a transformer, but there's no causal masking, so the entire input is processed all at once and the output generation is obviously different. I very strongly suspect this is also using a transformer.

data.title: Gemini figured out my nephew’s name
data.author: BeetleB
data.article_summary: 本文描述了作者通过一个自建的MCP服务器，赋予大型语言模型（Gemini）对其邮件的只读访问权限，成功找出了其侄子名字的过程。作者首先指示Gemini制定一个搜索策略，通过搜索Donovan发送的邮件中的关键词如“son”、“baby”、“name”等，逐步缩小范围。经过多次尝试和筛选，Gemini在一封主题为“Re: Monty”的邮件中，推断出Donovan的儿子名字是Monty。尽管邮件并未明确提到父子关系，但上下文强烈暗示Monty就是Donovan的儿子。最终，Gemini成功找出了名字，展示了有效的工具使用和搜索策略。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕使用AI工具（如Gemini）处理电子邮件相关任务的讨论，涉及工具使用、隐私安全、技术能力及其实际应用价值。

不同观点：
• **Syzygies**：主张在使用AI工具前必须进行讨论，认为许多AI指导方针无法执行，通过放松这些限制提高了效率。他强调在变量命名和代码完成后人工优化比AI自动生成更好，且主张把重要规则放在显眼位置以确保遵守。

• **h2782**：建议在处理电子邮件搜索用例之前，先让Gemini修复CSS，暗示AI工具应优先处理某些技术问题。

• **procaryote**：质疑AI通过推理得出“侄子名字”的实际能力，认为如果人类助理做出类似的研究结果，用户会感到失望，暗示AI的表现不如预期。

• **paffdragon**：对将电子邮件交给Gemini或其他第三方工具有隐私顾虑，表示不信任第三方工具，并提到因为不信任而选择自行开发工具，宁愿等待设备性能提升以实现本地处理。

• **renegat0x0**：以讽刺口吻表达对AI预测能力的担忧，提到如果AI能预测犯罪或投票行为，将引发更大的隐私和伦理问题。

• **jmull**：认为LLM（大型语言模型）技术既令人惊叹又有些平淡无奇，指出Gemini在电子邮件搜索任务中的表现与普通搜索功能相似，但对消耗的资源表示关注。

• **iamleppert**：以讽刺语气表示有些人会选择复杂的方式解决问题，而不是直接沟通，暗示有些AI应用可能过度复杂化简单任务。

• **throwawaybob420**：对AI能够通过数据得出信息表示惊叹，但语气带有讽刺，暗示AI的实际应用价值可能有限。

• **carimura**：提醒用户隐藏兄弟的电子邮件地址，关注隐私保护。

• **delichon**：对某个家庭命名习惯进行评论，偏离了技术讨论的主题。

• **jerrimu**：简单质疑用户是否忘记了侄子的名字，未深入讨论技术问题。

• **qntmfred**：分享了自己使用ChatGPT的经历，提到AI通过持续记忆功能最终推断出父亲的名字，暗示AI的学习能力有一定实用价值。

• **zombot**：对AI的“小把戏”表示不屑，认为这些技术并无实质性进步。

• **knorker**：批评2025年还有网站在移动设备上不工作，关注技术实现的基本可用性问题。

• 争议焦点之一是AI工具的实际应用价值和隐私安全问题。部分用户（如paffdragon和renegat0x0）对将个人信息交给AI工具表示担忧，而其他用户（如Syzygies和qntmfred）则关注AI工具的效率和学习能力。
• 对AI技术能力的评价存在分歧，一些用户（如procaryote和zombot）认为AI的表现低于预期，而另一些用户（如Syzygies和qntmfred）则认为AI在某些方面提高了效率或具有学习潜力。
• 技术实现的基本问题（如移动端兼容性）也被提及，显示出用户对技术细节的关注。

MCP
server

:
I need to know Donovan’s son’s name. It is buried in some email

NOT
use any tools
till we’ve discussed it through.
GEMINI
:
Okay, I will devise a strategy to find Donovan’s son’s name and
discuss it with you.
Strategy:
Search for emails from Donovan:
Use the
search_emails
tool
with a query like “from:Donovan”. This will give us a list of
email threads.
Search for keywords within Donovan’s emails:
Refine the search
to include keywords that might be associated with a son. For
example: “from:Donovan son”, “from:Donovan boy”, “from:Donovan
name is”. We can also try terms related to birth announcements if
we suspect the name might be in one, e.g., “from:Donovan born”,
“from:Donovan baby”.
Examine promising threads/messages:
If the search yields
specific messages or threads, I will suggest we look at their
content using
get_thread_by_id
or
get_message_content_by_id
.
Iterate:
If the initial searches are not successful, we can
try broader keywords or look for emails
to
Donovan that might
congratulate him or mention his son.

refine this strategy?

data.article_summary: 这篇文章讲述了肯塔基州一家名为AppHarvest的创业公司如何从承诺创造绿色工作机会到最终崩溃的过程。该公司计划建设高科技温室农场，为经济困难地区提供就业机会，并获得超过7亿美元的投资。然而，工人们却经历了恶劣的工作条件，西班牙语裔员工在重要人物来访时被隐匿，且工作环境充满不满。公司原本承诺的高薪、福利和晋升机会并未完全兑现，导致工人对公司失去信任。美国参议员麦康奈尔曾到访并赞扬该公司，但其言论引发争议，进一步暴露了公司内部的问题。最终，AppHarvest的愿景未能实现，工人们也深受影响。

LPM Investigations
A celebrated startup promised Kentuckians green jobs. It gave them a ‘grueling hell on earth.’
Louisville Public Media |
By
Austyn Gaffney
Published November 16, 2023 at 9:00 AM EST
Facebook
Twitter
LinkedIn
Email
Amelia K. Bates
/
Grist
The inside story of how AppHarvest’s indoor farming scheme imploded — and took its blue-collar workforce down with it.
This story was produced by Grist and was co-published with
the Kentucky Center for Investigative Reporting
.
The workers had spent the morning of November 8, 2021, clipping, trussing, and trellising hundreds of thousands of tomato plants that twisted almost four stories into the air. They were inside one of the world’s largest high-tech greenhouses, which sat on more than 60 acres of a former cattle field in Morehead, Kentucky.
As one of the greenhouse workers, who I’ll call Nora, sat down for lunch in the worker canteen, she heard her colleagues whisper about their new task for the day. U.S. Senator Mitch McConnell would be visiting that afternoon to make a speech praising the greenhouse company, AppHarvest. Before he arrived, management had to make sure their Spanish-speaking colleagues disappeared.
“We had very little time,” recalled Nora, whose real name is being withheld because she is subject to a nondisclosure agreement. “We had to get them off the premises and away before he got there.”
Nora watched her coworkers get dismissed, grab their stuff, and leave on white buses that resembled those used at the local prison, bound for a trio of small motels where the largely Mexican contract workers lived four or five to a room. When McConnell arrived, Nora joined her remaining, mostly-white colleagues on the sunny lawn, their clean t-shirts advertising AppHarvest’s name and logo, intended to invoke both the Appalachian region where they worked and the iconic branding of Apple — Silicon Valley by way of the middle American upstart.
“We all know the decline of the coal industry only got worse, and so this [AppHarvest] gives us hope,” the senator said, praising the local labor force encircling him. “You are the real leaders, I think, in beginning to fully develop all of Kentucky’s potential.”
It was a familiar message, one that had been touted over and over in nationally televised interviews, public filings, and company reports by AppHarvest’s then-CEO, a Kentucky native and entrepreneur named Jonathan Webb. In 2018, the then-32-year-old Webb returned home with the promise of building a dozen high-tech, hydroponic indoor farms across Eastern Kentucky and the surrounding region, growing tomatoes, cucumbers, berries, and lettuce. Not only would he be piloting an advanced form of climate-resilient agriculture, he would also be generating gainful, blue-collar employment in some of the country’s most economically-distressed counties, where
he argued that the coal industry’s downfall
left a void that could be filled by sustainable industry.
AppHarvest
Lettuce grows in AppHarvests’s Berea greenhouse.
Workers would start at $13 an hour, with hefty productivity bonuses and a track to internal promotions. Then there were the perks: 100 percent employer-paid health insurance premiums for both employees and their families, monthly boxes of fresh farm produce, and stock options once the company went public. In a region terrorized by the opioid epidemic, AppHarvest also offered jobs to formerly incarcerated people in recovery from addiction.
Webb’s worker-centric pitch raised over $700 million for AppHarvest to get off the ground and catapulted him into the national spotlight, with largely glowing coverage from The Wall Street Journal, The New York Times, CNN, and Forbes. It also convinced a number of big names to join the company’s board: Martha Stewart,
activist investor Jeffrey Ubben
, former Impossible Foods CFO David Lee, and JD Vance, the venture capitalist and
Hillbilly Elegy
author who would later win election to a U.S. senate seat in Ohio with a Trump-inspired, anti-immigrant message.
McConnell’s speech in Morehead highlighted another major theme in Appharvest’s advertising: replacing what Webb has called “dirty” agricultural imports from Mexico with safe, nutritious berries, lettuce, and tomatoes from Central Appalachia.
“I like the idea of taking the tomato market away from the Mexicans,” McConnell said that afternoon, according to an employee’s video recording of the event. Some workers looked around in surprise. Others seated behind McConnell rocked nervously in chairs, trying to catch the eyes of friends on the lawn. Applause can be heard in the recording, but at least one employee booed. The moment felt rigid and frail, like a ship just beginning to sink below the sea.
“No wonder they sent the fucking contractors [home],” one worker said, turning to a coworker off-camera.
The discontent that day wasn’t just about optics, or fairness to the contract workers. It was the culmination of a year of frustration with a company that had promised to

data.title: Did Akira Nishitani Lie in the 1994 Capcom vs. Data East Lawsuit?
data.author: danso
data.article_summary: 这篇文章讨论了1994年Capcom起诉Data East的案件，指控其游戏《Fighter’s History》抄袭《街头霸王II》。特别关注了《街头霸王II》联合设计师Akira Nishitani的证词，他在证词中声称游戏角色并未受其他作品启发，但这一说法与事实不符。文章分析了Nishitani为何做出这种声明，以及Capcom认为《Fighter’s History》抄袭的原因。尽管《Fighter’s History》与《街头霸王II》有诸多相似之处，法院最终裁定Data East未侵犯版权。文章还探讨了该案件的背景和结果，指出虽然《Fighter’s History》明显借鉴了《街头霸王II》，但Capcom未能从法律上证明其主张。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：对游戏角色和动作设计是否受其他来源影响的争议

不同观点：
• [mrandish的观点] 认为Nishitani在宣誓作证中声称《街头霸王II》的角色、动作和控制序列没有受到其他电子游戏或漫画书等来源的影响是难以置信的。他指出，任何文化和历史来源（如童话、传说、书籍、电影、漫画等）都可能对创作产生影响。然而，mrandish进一步分析，如果通过调整标点符号将证词解释为"我们没有从其他电子游戏或其他来源中获取角色的动作和控制序列"，这个说法就变得合理得多。他提到，当时的控制序列和动作组合可能是独特的，但不确定是否能受到法律保护。
  
• [bitwize的观点] 认为20世纪90年代制作日本格斗游戏的开发者们确实受到了诸如夸张的武术漫画、李小龙或成龙电影等文化作品的影响，并从中汲取灵感。bitwize举例说明，SNK的《拳皇》中的角色Benimaru Nikaido就是基于《JoJo的奇妙冒险》中的角色Polnareff设计的，许多游戏角色和动作都受到了已有作品的启发，只是为了避免诉讼而进行了调整和修改。他还指出，Capcom在设计《街头霸王》的波动拳（hadouken）时，可能借鉴了《宇宙战舰大和号》中的波动炮（hadouhou）的概念。

补充讨论：
• [关于标点符号影响的讨论] mrandish提到，在证词记录中，标点符号是由法院记录员添加的，可能会影响对原意的理解。Capcom的律师可能没有注意到这一点，或者他们接受了记录中的标点使用。Nishitani本人可能从未见过这份记录，这使得他的证词在不同解读下显得更加可信或不可信。

• [关于文化影响的讨论] bitwize强调了20世纪90年代日本格斗游戏开发者普遍受到漫画、电影等文化作品影响的事实，并通过具体例子（如Benimaru和Polnareff的相似性）来支持这一观点。这与mrandish关于标点符号调整使证词更可信的观点形成对照。

争议焦点：Nishitani的证词是否可信，以及《街头霸王II》的角色和动作设计是否受到了其他文化作品的影响。这涉及到对创作独立性和知识产权保护的讨论。

44035105.article_content:
Did Akira Nishitani Lie in the 1994 Capcom vs. Data East Lawsuit?
May 15
Written By
Drew Mackie
This article’s headline might seem like clickbait, I realize, but I couldn’t think of a snappier summary of what I’m discussing today. I’ve been looking through the documents surrounding the 1994 lawsuit in which Capcom alleged that Data East’s one-on-one martial combat game Fighter’s History ripped off Street Fighter II. And while I’ve found a few video game history gems buried in these legal papers, the most interesting document so far would have to be a deposition given by
Akira Nishitani
, co-designer of Street Fighter II, in which he claims that the game’s characters are not inspired by other sources, including video games and comic books.
Street Fighter’s Chun-Li vs. Fighter’s History’s Feilin.
If you’re even marginally aware of the Street Fighter series, you could probably guess that this claim is quite likely false, to the point that it might be surprising that there is a legal document in which Nishitani claims this “under penalty of perjury under the laws of the United States.” Granted, Nishitani gave his statement in Osaka, for whatever that’s worth, but there’s a substantial amount of research out there — and
on this website
— showing that much of the core Street Fighter II cast was drawn from other sources, including real-life martial artists, movies, comics (both manga and western) and other video games. And I’ll summarize all that in this piece, but I should also clarify that this is not my attempt to nail a beloved video game creator thirty years after the fact. No, I’m more interested in understanding why Nishitani would make such a claim and how the nuances of inspiration might have led to Capcom thinking that Data East’s game ripped theirs off.
In case you’re not clear what I’m talking about, here’s a Cliffs Notes summary of the whole thing. Capcom’s Street Fighter II hit arcades in March 1991, and its blockbuster success inspired many imitators that also wanted to cash in on the concept of fighters from countries all over the world convening and kicking the crap out of each other. Fatal Fury, for example, hit arcades in November 1991, and although you could argue superficial similarities, it wasn’t labeled a ripoff, both because it followed so quickly on the heels of SFII that it seemed to be developed concurrently and because it was designed by
Takashi Nishiyama
, who’d co-created the first Street Fighter.
Terry Bogard (not Ken) vs. Michael Max (not Balrog) in the first Final Fight game,
via
.
In a sense, Fatal Fury almost plays like a follow-up to the first Street Fighter, doing less to reinvent the genre than Street Fighter II did. (Plus there’s the fact that Fatal Fury’s lead character,
Terry Bogard
, makes
a covert cameo in Street Fighter I
, making his official introduction to the series in Street Fighter 6 seem a little less out of left field.)
You could argue a similar case for Fatal Fury’s sister series, Art of Fighting.
Ryo (not Ryu) vs. John Crawley (not Guile) in the first Art of Fighting,
via
.
That game’s director, Hiroshi Matsumoto, happened to be the other co-creator of the original Street Fighter, and while the Street Fighter series would eventually introduce the character
Dan Hibiki
as a parody of Art of Fighting’s leads,
Ryo Sakazaki
and
Robert Garcia
, nothing about this title so irked Capcom’s legal team that a lawsuit resulted.
Fighter’s History, released by Data East in March 1993, did capture Capcom’s attention — and not in a good way.
Marstorius (not Zangief) vs. Ray (not Ken) in Fighter’s History,
via
.
Fighter’s History shared all the gameplay basics seen in Street Fighter II but also Fatal Fury and Art of Fighting and countless other one-on-one fighters from this era. In the eyes of Capcom’s legal team, however, Fighter’s History did less to distinguish itself from the source material. In September 1993, Capcom filed a civil suit in both Japan and the United States claiming that Fighter’s History violated copyright. As such, Capcom sought to stop the distribution of the title in arcades, in addition to 623 million yen in damages. I explain some of this background
in this post
, but all you really need to know to understand this matter is that despite what might seem like a lot of evidence in Capcom’s favor, the matter resolved in October 1994 with Judge William Orrick ruling that whatever Data East had copied from Street Fighter II was not protected by copyright. That’s not to say that Fighter’s History wasn’t derivative of Street Fighter II or even more derivative of it than other one-on-one fighters from back in the day — just that the judge didn’t think Capcom had a legal claim to the elements it brought up in court. As a result, Fighter’s History got to continue existing, even if it never stood a chance of dethroning Street Fighter, which is alive and well today.
My background as a reporter was mostly with criminal court cases, not civil, so I don’t really know
44035105.article_summary: 这篇文章讨论了1994年Capcom起诉Data East的案件，指控其游戏《Fighter’s History》抄袭《街头霸王II》。特别关注了《街头霸王II》联合设计师Akira Nishitani的证词，他在证词中声称游戏角色并未受其他作品启发，但这一说法与事实不符。文章分析了Nishitani为何做出这种声明，以及Capcom认为《Fighter’s History》抄袭的原因。尽管《Fighter’s History》与《街头霸王II》有诸多相似之处，法院最终裁定Data East未侵犯版权。文章还探讨了该案件的背景和结果，指出虽然《Fighter’s History》明显借鉴了《街头霸王II》，但Capcom未能从法律上证明其主张。

不同观点：
• [mrandish的观点] 认为Nishitani在宣誓作证中声称《街头霸王II》的角色、动作和控制序列没有受到其他电子游戏或漫画书等来源的影响是难以置信的。他指出，任何文化和历史来源（如童话、传说、书籍、电影、漫画等）都可能对创作产生影响。然而，mrandish进一步分析，如果通过调整标点符号将证词解释为"我们没有从其他电子游戏或其他来源中获取角色的动作和控制序列"，这个说法就变得合理得多。他提到，当时的控制序列和动作组合可能是独特的，但不确定是否能受到法律保护。

• [关于文化影响的讨论] bitwize强调了20世纪90年代日本格斗游戏开发者普遍受到漫画、电影等文化作品影响的事实，并通过具体例子（如Benimaru和Polnareff的相似性）来支持这一观点。这与mrandish关于标点符号调整使证词更可信的观点形成对照。

data.title: CPanel's IPv6 Overhaul
data.author: ggm
data.article_summary: cPanel/WHM终于实现了对IPv6的全面支持，使得双栈（dual-stack）托管无需复杂变通方案。尽管IPv6早在2013年的第40版中就已引入，但由于SNI（服务器名称指示）无法用于共享IPv6地址，且服务器自身的IPv6前缀与分配给网站的地址前缀必须隔离，导致无法实现标准的双栈设置。The Network Crew Pty Ltd (TNC) 在构建基础设施时遇到了这些问题，并与APNIC合作解决了路由和IPv6实现中的障碍。通过与cPanel团队的密切合作，软件限制被逐步解除，包括取消IPv6前缀重叠限制和解决遗留警告问题。最终，cPanel在v126版本中解决了这些问题，并将其推广至所有发布分支，使全球用户能够轻松部署双栈网络。

44057768.article_content:
After years of limited support, IPv6 has finally been properly implemented in cPanel/WebHost Manager (WHM), enabling true dual-stack hosting without complex workarounds. Technically, IPv6 was implemented in version 40 of cPanel/WHM
back in 2013
. However, Server Name Indication (SNI) couldn’t be used to leverage a shared IPv6 address, nor could the server’s IPv6 be in the same prefix as the IPv6 range used to issue addresses to websites on the server.
With over
one million
websites now running on a cPanel/ WHM server, it became critical for the software to be updated for modern IPv6 implementations. This post investigates the new deployment, the issues encountered, and the fixes applied along the way.
Identifying the blockers
The original design of cPanel/WHM’s IPv6 imposed two key limitations: SNI could not be used in the traditional sense, and even if a shared IPv6 address was used, it was necessary to assign two isolated prefixes to each server — one for the machine, and one for shared use.
This prevented operators from deploying a standard dual-stack IPv4/IPv6 setup across their hosting fleets as an additional prefix was required purely for the servers themselves, despite there no longer being any technical necessity for that restriction.
As an APNIC Member, The Network Crew Pty Ltd (TNC) (AS138521) were delegated an IPv6 /32 in 2018 and gradually built out their infrastructure, working through blockers to deploy a successful dual-stack network. After finalizing their redundant network rebuild in 2024, it became clear that some key problems remained in the way of successful IPv6 deployment: First, oddities in RouterOS v7 routing; and secondly, the curious implementation of IPv6 in the cPanel/WHM software.
Through extensive work with
APNIC’s Technical Assistance Platform (TAP)
, TNC carried out a raft of configuration overhauls to bolster their network resilience, redundancy, and overall design before drilling into the
IPv6 implementation
. Checks were performed, configurations adjusted, tests conducted, and outcomes verified.
In terms of IPv6, TNC first checked with
Global Secure Layer
to verify that nothing required amendment on their side. The all-clear was given regarding routing, indicating the problem lay within the local network. Following investigation with the APNIC TAP, both core routers in TNC’s Sydney network were adjusted to have blackhole routes configured for their /32 IPv6 prefix, which allowed for outbound routing through GSL and future Internet Exchange Points (IXPs), including IX Australia and Edge IX.
This enabled dual-stack testing in the cPanel/WHM software, which exposed fatal problems when attempting to use the same prefix for both the server’s shared IPv6 and the IPv6 range used for hosted websites. With other issues resolved, it became clear that the final hurdle was to effect changes within the software to enable a straightforward and effective dual-stack implementation, without having to re-engineer the network into an unnecessarily complex configuration.
Escalating the cPanel fix
The Network Crew Pty Ltd has been a cPanel Partner Network Operations Centre (Partner NOC) since 2017, and in that time has forged valuable connections within cPanel (now WebPros). This facilitated direct dialogue with Account Management, Engineering, Software Managers, and Developers/Engineers to implement the necessary changes within the product so that TNC — and users globally — could deploy dual-stack without needing complex addressing schemes to work around outdated restrictions.
Across several months in 2024, our team maintained regular contact, then fortnightly meetings, with the cPanel Development team leaders. Together, we identified, understood, and resolved the blockers in the software. After confirming that the IPv6 implementation had remained untouched for several years, the ideal approach was determined. We would introduce small changes with the greatest impact. In practice, this meant removing the IPv6 overlap restriction and resolving legacy warnings.
These changes were first published in development build v125.9999.100, which resolved case RE-1211 by enabling support for nested prefixes. cPanel provided this build to TNC for internal testing, which confirmed a successful deployment. However, testing uncovered an erroneous warning in the software. That issue was raised as case RE-1358 and subsequently addressed in cPanel
v126
, alongside the prefix overlap fix. v126 has now reached the STABLE release tier and has since been promoted to the Long-Term Support (LTS) tier as well. This means the improvements are now available globally across all release branches.
TNC is grateful for the support of WebPros/cPanel staff who made the changes possible, particularly Adam Wien, Todd Rinaldo, and Elena Deryabina, who were instrumental in driving the successful fixes through to publication.
Deploying IPv6, SNI or not
Since the promotion of cPanel/WHM to the STABLE tier, which TNC runs internally,

data.title: News publishers call Google's AI Mode 'theft'
data.author: cheeaun
data.article_summary: 美国新闻出版商联盟（News/Media Alliance）批评谷歌扩展的AI模式，称其新功能通过AI聊天机器人界面直接使用出版商内容，如Condé Nast和Vox Media，而不返还流量和收入，构成“掠夺”。谷歌在I/O大会上宣布该模式向所有美国用户开放，当用户查询时，AI模式会提供生成答案和相关链接。联盟CEO Danielle Coffey指出，链接曾是搜索给出版商带来流量和收入的唯一优势，而现在谷歌未经许可使用内容，属于 theft（盗窃）。内部文件显示，谷歌决定不在AI搜索功能中征求出版商许可，出版商只能完全退出搜索结果。谷歌搜索主管Liz Reid表示，允许出版商选择退出个别功能会增加复杂性。联盟呼吁司法部采取措施，防止谷歌一家独大。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：新闻出版商将许多行为称为“盗窃”的合理性

不同观点：
• CamperBob2认为新闻出版商过度使用“盗窃”一词，将其应用于各种情况，可能夸大了这些行为的严重性。这个观点暗示出版商可能在通过这种方式来引起公众对版权问题的关注，但实际效果可能会削弱“盗窃”一词的真正含义。

• 另一种观点（未直接出现，但可以从对立角度推测）可能认为，新闻出版商将未经授权使用其内容的行为称为“盗窃”是合理的，因为这种行为确实侵犯了他们的知识产权，损害了他们的经济利益。这种观点可能会强调保护版权的重要性，以确保内容创作者的劳动得到回报。

补充讨论：
• CamperBob2的评论反映了公众中一部分人对版权法和知识产权保护的冷漠或反对态度，可能认为出版商在过度维权。
• 争议的焦点在于“盗窃”一词的适用范围，以及未经授权使用内容的行为是否应该被视为与传统盗窃相同性质的犯罪。
• 另一个值得注意的讨论点是，版权保护和公众获取信息之间的平衡问题。这涉及到版权法如何在保护创作者权益和确保信息自由流动之间找到一个合适的平衡点。

44057811.article_content:
News
News publishers call Google’s AI Mode ‘theft’
The News/Media Alliance says Google ‘just takes content by force and uses it with no return’ to publishers like Condé Nast and Vox Media.
The News/Media Alliance says Google ‘just takes content by force and uses it with no return’ to publishers like Condé Nast and Vox Media.
by
Emma Roth
May 21, 2025, 9:18 PM UTC
Link
Facebook
Threads
Image: Cath Virginia / The Verge
Emma Roth
is a news writer who covers the streaming wars, consumer tech, crypto, social media, and much more. Previously, she was a writer and editor at MUO.
The trade association backing some of the biggest news publishers in the US slammed Google’s newly expanded AI Mode, which trades traditional search results for an AI chatbot-like interface. In
a statement on Wednesday
, the News/Media Alliance said the new feature is “depriving” publishers of both traffic and revenue.
During Google I/O on Tuesday, the company announced
that it’s expanding AI Mode to all users
in the US, which appears in a new tab directly within Search. When users enter a query, AI Mode serves up an AI-generated response alongside a list of relevant links.
“Links were the last redeeming quality of search that gave publishers traffic and revenue,” Danielle Coffey, the CEO and president of News/Media Alliance, said in the statement. “Now Google just takes content by force and uses it with no return, the definition of theft. The DOJ remedies must address this to prevent continued domination of the internet by one company.”
Related
Google rejected giving publishers more choice to opt out of AI Search
AI Mode is obviously the future of Google Search
This week, an internal document disclosed as part of Google’s antitrust trial over its search dominance showed that the company
decided against
asking publishers for permission to have their work included in its AI search features,
as reported by
Bloomberg
. Instead, publishers must opt out of search results completely if they don’t want their work included in AI features.
Google Search head Liz Reid said during her testimony that allowing publishers to opt out of individual features would add “enormous complexity,” according to
Bloomberg
. “By saying a publisher could be like, ‘I want to be in this feature but not that feature,’ it doesn’t work,” Reid said. “Because then we would essentially have to say, every single feature on the page needs a different model.”

data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：应对挣扎和心理健康问题的方法

不同观点：
• [支持与共情] datatrashfire表达了对挣扎的同情和希望找到个人解决方法的祝愿，未提供具体建议。
• [行为疗法与习惯] dotdashdashdash建议通过Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT) 来识别目标和价值观，并通过批量处理任务来管理日常事务。
• [药物与副作用] golly_ned和adiabatichottub对药物持怀疑态度，强调药物可能干扰睡眠，并建议通过睡眠、饮食、运动等自然方法来改善状况。
• [药物与剂量] adamwk分享了从Vyvanse换到Concerta的正面经验，同时指出换工作对状态的改善作用。thw09j9m则提到擅自增加Vyvanse剂量的短期效果。
• [哲学视角] GianFabien建议通过改变视角来应对困境，推荐阅读存在主义文学作品，认为无需药物治疗。
• [诊断与治疗] interstice和rickmode强调诊断出具体问题（如抑郁、ADHD、倦怠）的重要性，然后根据诊断结果进行治疗。
• [自我反思与重塑] notaharvardmba建议通过反思过去五年，重新设定人生目标和意义，以应对当前的困境。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点在于药物治疗的有效性和副作用问题，部分评论者认为药物可能弊大于利，而另一些人则认为药物有短期帮助。
• 不同评论者提供了多种非药物治疗方法，如行为疗法、习惯养成、运动和睡眠管理等，显示出多维度综合应对策略的必要性。
• 存在主义视角提供了一种哲学层面的应对策略，强调改变对问题的看法而非依赖外部干预。
• 诊断的必要性被多次提及，说明在处理心理健康问题时，明确问题根源是制定有效解决方案的关键。

data.title: Inigo Quilez: computer graphics, mathematics, shaders, fractals, demoscene
data.author: federicoponzi
data.article_summary: 这篇文章介绍了一个包含计算机图形学教程和资源的网页，提供了视频和文字教程。文字教程为作者业余时间编写，可能存在错误或不精确之处。教程涵盖了多种主题，包括函数索引、3D/2D符号距离场（SDFs）、光线追踪、噪声处理、体积渲染、压缩技术、光线行进、纹理过滤、照明、渲染器/引擎、数学技巧及分形等。所有代码片段均采用MIT许可证，允许重用。读者可以通过Patreon或PayPal支持该教程的创作。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：对Inigo Quilez（iq）在计算机图形学、 demoscene领域贡献的赞赏与讨论

不同观点：
• [ykl] 强调Inigo Quilez在Pixar期间开发Wondermoss系统的贡献，特别是其在《勇敢传说》中应用的创新技术，如实时编码和极低的记忆体消耗。Wondermoss系统实现了几乎全部植被的程序化生成，极大提升了渲染效率和视觉复杂度。

• [onename] 则通过介绍Inigo在demoscene（演示场景）中的作品《Elevated》来展示其才华，强调在仅4KB大小的情况下创造出惊人的视觉效果，突显其在程序化图形方面的造诣。

• [gxd] 分享了自己对demoscene的热爱，并提到在自己的游戏《Outsider》中特别提到了demoscene文化，显示出Inigo及其作品对不同领域创作者的深远影响。

• [emigre] 推荐Inigo的视频《Painting a Character with Maths》，表明其内容对数学与图形学的结合有深入探讨，值得观看。

• [eloycoto] 表达了对Inigo文章的感谢，特别是在个人困难时期（肿瘤治疗）这些文章带来的帮助和乐趣，展现了Inigo作品对个人的积极影响。

• [modeless] 提到Inigo最近参与的播客，表明Inigo不仅在技术上有贡献，还通过多种媒体分享知识，扩大其影响力。

• [danielbarla] 赞赏Inigo提供的免费学习资源，强调其对教育和学习的贡献，特别是高质量且易于获取的学习材料。

• [rossant] 和 [binary132] 都对Inigo给予高度评价，称其为“传奇”和“天才”，并希望他的YouTube频道能获得更多关注。

• [ramesh31] 特别提到Inigo参与的《The Good Dinosaur》电影，认为这是Pixar最美的电影之一，进一步证明其在电影图形技术上的成就。

• [ashoeafoot] 幽默地指出Inigo在ShaderToy平台上受到广泛关注，很多受欢迎的作品都出自他手。

• [ostwilkens] 则指出Inigo的作品和平台是学习raymarching（光线步进）技术的重要资源，对新手进入demoscene生产有很大帮助。

补充讨论：
Inigo Quilez的影响不仅限于技术领域，他的作品和文章在个人层面上也对一些人产生了积极影响，如在困难时期提供了精神支持和乐趣。此外，Inigo通过多种媒体和平台（如ShaderToy、文章、视频和播客）分享知识，使其影响力扩展到了更广泛的受众。

data.title: Kotlin-Lsp: Kotlin Language Server and Plugin for Visual Studio Code
data.author: todsacerdoti
data.article_summary: Kotlin LSP 是一个为 Kotlin 语言提供的 Visual Studio Code 插件，基于 IntelliJ IDEA 和 Language Server Protocol (LSP) 实现，目前处于预览前的探索阶段。该项目支持 JVM Kotlin Gradle 项目的基本功能，如项目导入、代码导航、代码操作、重构和代码完成等，但仅限 JVM 项目。当前版本适合实验和玩具项目，不建议日常使用，因其稳定性未得到保证。该插件主要在 macOS 和 Linux 平台的 VS Code 上测试通过，其他 LSP 编辑器需手动配置。部分源码暂时闭源，未来将完全开源。反馈和问题可通过 GitHub 提交。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Kotlin语言及其开发工具支持，特别是对IntelliJ IDEA和VSCode等IDE的偏好与争议。

不同观点：
• [eitland] 认为Kotlin与IntelliJ的强绑定让他犹豫是否推荐Kotlin，尽管他承认IntelliJ是优秀的工具。他个人更偏好其他免费的Java IDE，并认为这种偏好是个人化的。
• [travisgriggs] 强烈支持在不同编程语言使用专用IDE，例如Android Studio用于Kotlin，VSCode仅用于轻量级任务。他认为IDE有其专门用途，不应一概而论地使用VSCode。
• [matthew-craig] 表示无法在Emacs中使用Kotlin阻碍了他使用该语言，并希望JetBrains能推出Java LSP，甚至愿意为此付费。
• [jerryslm] 呼吁关注Kotlin在Eclipse上的支持，希望能够使用Eclipse进行Kotlin开发。
• [andy800] 认为Kotlin在年轻开发者中不如JS、TS、Python等流行，因此JetBrains应主动将Kotlin带到开发者常用的平台，而非仅依赖IntelliJ。
• [twen_ty] 质疑在Java 21/23之后继续使用Kotlin的必要性，特别是考虑到Kotlin是专有语言。

补充讨论：
• 一些用户如[directstar2]和[pjmlp]对JetBrains是否会持续支持Kotlin在其他平台（如VSCode）表示怀疑，提及其过去在Android上的经历和对Eclipse插件的支持中止。
• [flykespice] 和 [wiseowise] 对JetBrains终于支持VSCode表示欢迎，但前者对该支持能否持久持怀疑态度。
• [satoru42] 报告了在Cursor上安装Kotlin插件时遇到的兼容性问题。
• [mdaniel] 对Kotlin LSP部分闭源表示强烈不满，质疑JetBrains的开源策略。

争议焦点：
• Kotlin与IntelliJ的强绑定是否合理，是否应更多支持其他IDE如VSCode和Eclipse。
• Kotlin在现代开发中的定位和相对于Java的优势，特别是在Java不断更新的情况下。
• JetBrains对Kotlin支持其他平台的态度和执行力，以及开源与闭源策略的争议。

The project is in an experimental, pre-alpha, exploratory phase
with the intention to be productionized.
We
move fast, break things
, and explore various aspects of the seamless developer experience
including Java interoperability, limits of IntelliJ capabilities as a standalone server, native binaries of the LSP, and
debug capabilities.
The LSP supports most of the essential parts, but its final shape is not near to be defined and
even the most basic and core parts are being changed on a regular basis.
So we have the corresponding stability guarantees --
none
. It is okay to use it in your toy
projects, to experiment with it and to provide your feedback, but it is not recommended
to depend on its stability in your day-to-day work.
Supported platforms
In the current state, the golden path has been tested for Visual Studio Code with macOS and Linux platforms.
You can use Kotlin LSP with other LSP-compliant editors, but configuration must be done manually.
Please note that Kotlin LSP uses pull-based diagnostics, so the editor must support that.
You can find a standalone LSP launch script in
kotlin-lsp.sh
along
with
very experimental
(aka "works on someone's machine") instructions that setup LSP for other editors in
scripts
folder.
See
./kotlin-lsp.sh --help
for available options.
Source code
Currently, the LSP implementation is partially closed-source, primarily for the sake of development speed convenience --
it heavily depends on parts of IntelliJ, Fleet, and our distributed Bazel build that allows us to
iterate quickly and experiment much faster, cutting corners and re-using internal infrastructure where it helps.
After the initial stabilization phase and defining the final set of capabilities, we will de-couple the LSP implementation from the internal repository
and build pipelines and open source it completely (with an explicit dependency on IntelliJ), this is a temporary constraint.
VSC extension is mirrored into
kotlin-vscode
as it does not depend on anything internal.
Feedback and issues
The best way to provide your feedback or report an issue is to file a bug
in GitHub issues
.
As a temporary limitation, direct contributions are not supported as this repository is a read-only mirror,
but it is possible to open a PR into the documentation, and it will be integrated manually by maintainers.

data.title: A lost decade chasing distributed architectures for data analytics?
data.author: andreasha
data.article_summary: 本文探讨了在2012年的MacBook Pro上运行DuckDB数据库的性能表现，以评估过去十年中分布式数据分析架构是否必要。作者指出，随着硬件性能的快速提升，许多数据集其实可以在单节点上高效处理，"数据奇点"可能比预期更早到来。通过在2012年的MacBook Pro上运行TPC-H基准测试，作者发现即便内存远小于数据集大小，该老旧设备仍能完成所有查询任务，且耗时在1分钟到30分钟之间，表现令人惊讶。文章暗示，过去十年可能过度追求分布式架构，而忽视了个人电脑的处理能力。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕DuckDB及大数据分析技术的讨论，涉及不同数据库技术的比较、实时分析与预计算分析的对比、以及技术选择背后的动机和生态系统。

不同观点：
• tonyhart7认为DuckDB在开源项目分析工具中的应用较少，更多见到的是ClickHouse、Postgres等。

• braza引用文章讨论历史上的技术选择，认为虽然DuckDB等技术可能在过去未被重视，但当时分布式系统的选择有其背景和动机。
• rr808批评大数据团队过度使用复杂技术（如Scala和Spark）处理小数据集，导致开发效率低下。
• Mortiffer强调R语言在小数据处理中的优势，认为CRAN包的高质量和维护机制使其在处理小数据时更为合适。
• roenxi指出数据库设计不仅要考虑常见查询，还要关注极端情况下的查询能力，认为像Redshift这样的数据库在处理极端查询时有其价值。
• zkmon认为数据库选择不仅关乎查询性能，还要考虑公司文化、流程、工作流、合规要求等复杂生态系统因素。
• willvarfar分享了使用DuckDB处理大数据集的实际经验，认为DuckDB在分析过程中极大地提高了工作效率和便利性。
• simlevesque寻求计算资源支持其DuckDB相关研究项目。
• culebron21回顾了过去关于分布式数据库的设想，并讨论了其潜在问题和现代技术的对比。
• godber认为将大数据限定在“单机可处理的最大数据集”范围内是有道理的。
• steveBK123质疑大数据技术选择背后的商业动机，认为VC资助的解决方案更倾向于将用户锁定在云环境中。
• mehulashah指出过去技术选择有其现实需求，认为若数据能在一台旧MacBook Pro上处理，则应选择适合的方案，但也承认历史需求推动了分布式系统的发展。

补充讨论：
• 争议的焦点在于实时交互式分析与预计算分析的价值对比，以及不同技术选择的适用场景和动机。
• 另一个值得注意的讨论点是数据库选择不仅关乎技术性能，还涉及生态系统和商业动机等多方面因素。
• 历史背景和技术发展路径也是讨论的重要部分，尤其是过去技术选择的原因和现代技术的反思。

44027690.article_content:
The Lost Decade of Small Data?
Hannes Mühleisen
Published on
2025-05-19
Reading time: 9 minutes
TL;DR: We benchmark DuckDB on a 2012 MacBook Pro to decide: did we lose a decade chasing distributed architectures for data analytics?
Much has been said, not in the very least by ourselves, about how
data is actually not that “Big”
and how the speed of hardware innovation is outpacing the growth of useful datasets. We may have gone so far to
predict a data singularity in the near future
, where 99% of useful datasets can be comfortably queried on a single node. As
recently shown
, the median scan in Amazon Redshift and Snowflake reads a doable 100 MB of data, and the 99.9-percentile reads less than 300 GB. So the singularity might be closer than we think.
But we started wondering, when did this development really start? When did personal computers like the ubiquitous MacBook Pro, usually condemned to running Chrome, become the data processing powerhouses that they really are today?
Let's turn our attention to the
2012
Retina MacBook Pro
, a computer many people (myself included) bought at the time because of its gorgeous “Retina” display. Millions were sold. Despite being unemployed at the time, I had even splurged for the 16 GB RAM upgrade. But there was another often-forgotten revolutionary change in this machine: it was the first MacBook with a built-in Solid-State Disk (SSD)
and
a competitive
4-core 2.6 GHz “Core i7” CPU
. It's funny to watch the
announcement
again, where they
do
stress the performance aspect of the “all-flash architecture” as well.
Side note: the MacBook Air was actually the first MacBook with an (optional) built-in SSD already back in 2008. But it did not have the CPU firepower of the Pro, sadly.
Coincidentally, I still have this laptop in the
DuckDB Labs
office, currently used by my kids to type their names in a massive font size or watch Bluey on YouTube when they're around. But can this relic still run modern-day DuckDB? How will its performance compare to modern MacBooks? And could we have had the data revolution that we are seeing now already back in 2012? Let's find out!
Software
First, what about the operating system? In order to make the comparison fair(er) to the decades, we actually
downgraded
the operating system on the Retina to OS X 10.8.5 “Mountain Lion”, the operating system version that shipped just a few weeks after the laptop itself in July 2012. Even though the Retina can actually run 10.15 (Catalina), we felt a true 2012 comparison should also use an operating system from the era. Below is a screenshot of the user interface for those of us who sometimes feel a little old.
Moving on to DuckDB itself: here at DuckDB we are more than a little religious about portability and dependencies – or rather the lack thereof. This means that very little had to happen to make DuckDB run on the ancient Mountain Lion: the stock DuckDB binary is built with by default with backwards-compatibility to OS X 11.0 (Big Sur), but simply changing the flag and recompiling turned out to be enough to make DuckDB 1.2.2 run on Mountain Lion. We would have loved to also use a 2012 compiler to build DuckDB, but, alas, C++ 11 was unsurprisingly simply
too new
in 2012 to be fully supported by compilers. Either way, the binary runs fine and could have been also produced by working around the compiler bugs. Or we could have just hand-coded Assembly like
others have done
.
Benchmarks
But we're not interested in synthetic CPU scores, we're interested in
synthetic SQL scores
instead! To see how the old machine is holding up when performing
serious
data crunching, we used the
at this point rather tired but well-known TPC-H benchmark
at scale factor 1000. This means that the two main tables,
lineitem
and
orders
contain 6 and 1.5 Billion rows, respectively. When stored as a DuckDB database, the database has a size of ca. 265 GB.
From the
audited results on the TPC website
, we can see that running the benchmark on this scale factor on a single node seems to require hardware costing hundreds of thousands of Dollars.
We ran each of the 22 benchmark queries five times, and took the median runtime to remove noise. However, because the amount of RAM (16 GB) is very much less than the database size (256 GB), no significant amount of the input data can be cached in the buffer manager, so those are not really what people sometimes call “hot” runs.

data.author: gmays
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：对一篇关于自然界长期地质痕迹的论文及其相关概念的讨论

不同观点：
• [gnabgib] 认为该论文非常易读，并分享了论文链接。他侧重于论文的可读性和学术价值。
• [adityaathalye] 引用了Silurian Hypothesis（志留纪假说）来表达对地质痕迹长期保存的感慨，特别是提到自然现象如冰川、海平面变化和侵蚀对地质痕迹的影响。他还通过引用网络讨论，幽默地指出鲨鱼作为一种长期存在的生物的独特性。
• [veunes] 则对论文中提到的“爪子”这一细节印象深刻，认为这一小解剖特征传递了丰富的信息。

补充讨论：
• [adityaathalye] 的评论中提到了自然现象如冰川和海平面变化，这暗示了他对地质痕迹如何在长时间尺度上受到环境影响的关注。
• 争议焦点似乎并不明显，但[adityaathalye] 对鲨鱼“永恒”存在的幽默评论可能引起不同读者的兴趣或质疑，因为它偏离了主要学术讨论，进入了轻松的网络文化领域。
• [veunes] 的评论聚焦于论文中的具体细节，显示出对解剖学特征在理解古生物方面的重要性。

总体来看，评论者们对论文的可读性、地质痕迹的长期保存以及具体细节（如爪子）展开了多角度的讨论。

data.title: Decibels Are Ridiculous
data.author: Ariarule
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点： decibel（分贝）在不同工程领域中的应用及其优缺点

不同观点：
• **支持分贝的实用性**：
   - **简化计算**：分贝可以将乘法转化为加法，方便处理增益和衰减（例如，滤波器损耗和放大器增益可以直接相加）。
   - **处理极大极小值**：分贝可以方便地表示和处理数量级差异很大的数值，避免使用科学计数法或处理复杂的浮点运算。
   - **多种工程领域应用**：在RF工程、音频工程、雷达等领域，分贝提供了一个统一的标度，便于比较不同数量级的信号。
   - **历史惯性**：尽管分贝有其复杂性，但由于历史原因，它已成为行业标准，改变的成本高。

• **批评分贝的复杂性和不一致性**：
   - **单位不明确**：分贝的定义和使用在不同上下文中存在不一致，特别是相对和绝对测量的混用（例如dBm、dB(SPL)、dB(A)等）。
   - **电压与功率的混淆**：分贝在处理电压与功率时采用不同的比率（电压是20倍的对数，功率是10倍的对数），容易引起混淆。
   - **主观校准**：例如音频VU表的校准基于主观模型，历史上由BBC和一些美国公司定义，缺乏客观标准。

• **对分贝的矛盾态度**：
   - **理解难度**：尽管分贝在工程中广泛使用，但其概念和应用对新手来说可能过于复杂，尤其是不同单位之间的转换和使用。
   - **历史遗留问题**：尽管认识到分贝的某些缺点，但工程师们因历史原因仍继续使用它，类似于软件工程中的某些历史遗留协议和工具。

补充讨论：
• **具体应用实例**：

data.title: Dijkstra on Ada
data.author: cpeterso
data.article_summary: 这篇文章简要介绍了Dijkstra对四种早期编程语言提案（红、绿、蓝、黄）的评价，这些提案最终演变为Ada语言，其中绿色提案获胜。Dijkstra对各提案的评价非常严厉：红色提案“既先进又落后，令人困惑”；绿色提案“技术无能，可能还带有不诚实”；蓝色提案“过于复杂”，“技术文档和销售话术混杂”；黄色提案“无可救药的混乱”。在被问及对Ada的看法时，Dijkstra表示Ada的混乱让他担忧西方安全依赖于此，并开玩笑说如果红军也采用Ada，他会感到更安全。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕Ada和Rust编程语言的评价与争议，以及对历史上编程语言选择过程的讨论。

不同观点：
• [rini17] 认为现代Ada是合理且不过分冗长的，并将其与Java比较。同时，对Rust的未来表示担忧，质疑将遗留的DoD C代码用AI重写为Rust的潜在风险。
• [phtrivier] 希望看到更完整的评论，并顺便提到Dijkstra如果使用社交媒体可能会浪费时间与网友争论，暗指Dijkstra的个性可能导致不必要的争论。
• [cyco130] 提供了历史背景信息，指出Ada是从多个提案中选出的，其中绿色方案获选，红色方案是备选。
• [johnisgood] 表示需要更多背景信息，认为评论中对Ada的厌恶表达缺乏理由支持，要求更详细的解释。
• [ggm] 回忆Wirth可能在Ada早期候选阶段提出了Modula/Modula-2变体，并通过三点推理支持这一观点，指出Dijkstra可能批评了所有候选语言。

补充讨论：
• [zombot] 表示对讨论内容感到困惑，无法理解。
• [mcv] 评论Dijkstra言辞犀利。
• [hello_computer] 质疑Dijkstra是否对任何事物有正面评价。
• [f1shy] 请求更多背景信息，特别是关于其他颜色提案的内容。
• [Surac] 以幽默方式评论男性只能区分6种颜色，暗示讨论中的某些观点可能与性别刻板印象有关。

争议焦点：
• 对Ada和Rust语言的评价存在分歧，特别是对Rust未来发展的担忧。
• 对历史编程语言选择过程的具体细节和背景信息的需求与提供之间的矛盾。
• 对Dijkstra个性及其评论风格的个人解读和评价。

44057731.article_content:
Dijkstra was one of the reviewers of the fours language proposals which eventually lead to the language Ada: red, green, blue, and yellow (the winning proposal was green). Here are some quotes from each of the reviews:
red
“the proposal is both advanced and backward in such an incongruous manner that I am baffled”
green
“technical incompetence, probably enhanced by dishonesty”
“I tried to reconstruct from the documentation a coherent design philosophy, an effort in which I failed: the mixture between sense and nonsense remained baffling”
blue
“the blue language is unacceptably complex”
“these documents are a inextricable mixture of technical documentation and salestalk”
“if we see a crazy argument, are we then allowed to conclude that the authors are idiots?”
yellow
“an unsalvageable mess”
In a conversation with Andrei P. Ershov (Soviet computer scientist), when asked about his view on Ada, Dijkstra commented that “
Ada was such a mess that I shuddered at the thought that Western security would depend on it and that I would feel much safer if the Red Army were to adopt it as well.
” [EWD1057].

data.title: What Sam Altman Told OpenAI About the Secret Device He's Making with Jony Ive
data.author: mfiguiere
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：OpenAI及相关公司是否应开发消费者设备，以及其在消费市场或B2B市场中的潜力。

不同观点：
• [aucisson_masque] 认为Apple和Google在AI创新方面进展缓慢，而Microsoft通过与OpenAI合作，已经将ChatGPT等AI功能集成到Office和Paint等软件中，接触到数亿消费者。因此，OpenAI需要通过构建设备直接与消费者互动。
• [weinzierl] 质疑OpenAI是否会开发消费者设备，还是专注于B2B市场。他认为如果面向企业市场，可能不需要像Jony Ive这样的设计师。
• [HacklesRaised] 强调需要看到OpenAI实际展示其能力，而不仅仅是宣传。他认为现在应该是OpenAI用实际行动来证明其潜力的时候。
• [camillomiller] 提出了一系列质疑，包括OpenAI模型的输出质量、目标用户群体、市场兴趣以及其硬件和供应链经验是否足够支持成功推出基于ChatGPT的产品。

补充讨论：
• 争议的焦点在于OpenAI是否具备足够的资源和能力来成功进入硬件市场，以及其潜在市场是消费者市场还是企业市场。
• 有人认为Microsoft已经在软件层面成功将AI功能推向市场，因此OpenAI可能不需要自行开发硬件。
• 还有人指出，OpenAI需要用实际成果来回应外界的期望，特别是在硬件开发方面。

data.title: Obsidian Bases
data.author: Brajeshwar
data.article_summary: Obsidian于2025年5月21日发布了1.9.0版本，引入了一个新的核心插件“Bases”，允许用户将笔记转化为数据库，支持自定义表视图、数据过滤和动态属性。新版推出了“Footnotes view”插件，改进了多项功能，如脚注管理、PDF导出和同步历史视图。此外，取消了对某些属性的支持，并进行了多项界面和编辑体验的优化。开发方面，更新了CSS、YAML处理和多项技术组件。当前Bases处于早期测试阶段，未来将加入更多功能和API支持。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Obsidian中的Bases功能替代Dataview的潜力及其实际应用

不同观点：
• [支持Bases替代Dataview] Bases被视为Dataview的优秀替代品，提供更好的支持和更简单的语法。此外，Bases计划支持Obsidian Publish，而Dataview从未支持此功能。然而，由于Dataview的开发停滞，用户对其未来发展感到担忧。[lordfrikk]
• [对数据迁移的关注] 一位用户表达了对类似工具Notion的担忧，尤其是数据迁移的困难，并询问Bases是否能够方便地附加文件到笔记中以增强数据的可迁移性。[smodo]
• [个人信息管理用途] 一位用户认为Bases类似于1Password，但用于非秘密信息管理，例如记录家庭成员的个人信息。该用户强调Bases的发现能力优于简单笔记。[dmazin]

补充讨论：
• [技术实现细节] 一位用户指出Bases使用带有.base扩展名的yaml文件，并提供了相关帮助链接。[burgerrito]
• [安装问题] 一位用户询问如何在Linux上下载最新版本的Bases，因为网站上仍然显示旧版本。[Loxicon]
• [期待尝试] 一位用户对Bases表示兴趣，并希望尝试查看.base文件的具体表现。[vancroft]

争议焦点：
• Dataview的开发停滞导致用户寻找替代方案，而Bases被视为一个有潜力的继任者，但用户对其具体功能（如文件附加和跨平台支持）仍有疑问。

总结：用户对Bases作为Dataview替代品表示了兴趣，尤其是其简化的语法和未来功能支持。然而，用户在文件附加和跨平台下载方面存在一些疑问，显示出对实用性和便利性的关注。

data.title: JEP 519: Compact Object Headers
data.author: Skinney
data.article_summary: JEP 519 提议将紧凑对象头（Compact Object Headers）从实验性功能转变为正式产品功能。该功能最初作为实验性功能在 JDK 24 中引入，经过测试证明其稳定性和性能优越，包括在 Oracle 和亚马逊的生产环境中得到了验证。测试显示，启用紧凑对象头后，SPECjbb2015 基准测试的堆空间使用减少了 22%，CPU 时间减少了 8%，垃圾收集次数减少了 15%，且 JSON 解析 benchmark 运行时间缩短了 10%。因此，现在是将其从实验性功能升级为正式功能的时候。升级后，将不再需要通过命令行选项 `-XX:+UnlockExperimentalVMOptions` 来启用该功能。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：JEP 519 关于启用紧凑对象头（Compact Object Headers）的默认设置及其性能影响

不同观点：
• **nicktelford** 认为 JEP 519 没有默认启用紧凑对象头是不合理的。他认为大多数用户不会特意去启用该功能，如果该功能已经被确认为稳定且能提升性能，就应该默认开启。他还提到，JVM 过去因为需要复杂的标志来优化性能（尤其是GC配置）而声名狼藉，尽管现在有所改善，但 JEP 519 似乎在这一方面又开了一个倒车。

• **SerCe** 则指出，先前的 JEP 450 提供了更多关于该功能的实现细节。该功能已经在 Oracle 和亚马逊进行了广泛测试，包括整个 JDK 测试套件和亚马逊生产环境中的数百个服务。SerCe 认为，在大公司中，平台团队有更多的机会和资源来测试和量化性能改进，而这是其他人难以获得的。

• **hmottestad** 对 JEP 519 的性能结果表示赞赏，特别是提到 JSON 解析基准测试显示了 10% 的性能提升。不过，他并没有对默认启用问题提出质疑，而是更关注性能改进的具体表现。

• **kosolam** 提出了一个问题，即该 JEP 是否也能提高 GraalVM 原生镜像的可执行文件的效率。这表明他对该功能在不同环境或工具链下的适用性表示关注。

补充讨论：
• 争议的焦点在于 JEP 519 没有默认启用紧凑对象头，这引发了 nicktelford 对用户体验和易用性的担忧，而 SerCe 则通过实际测试数据来支持该功能的可行性和稳定性。
• 该功能的具体性能提升效果得到了 hmottestad 的肯定，尤其是在 JSON 解析基准测试中的表现。
• kosolam 提出了该功能在 GraalVM 环境下的适用性问题，这是一个值得进一步探讨的方向。

Reviewed by

Endorsed by
Vladimir Kozlov
Created
2025/04/15 14:01
Updated
2025/05/21 16:18
Issue
8354672
Summary
Change compact object headers from an experimental feature to a product feature.
Non-Goals
It is not a goal to make compact object headers be the default object-header layout.
Motivation
Compact object headers were introduced as an alternative object-header layout by
JEP 450
in JDK 24. Features of this size are best introduced carefully and gradually, so we introduced it as an experimental feature.
Since JDK 24, compact object headers have proven their stability and performance.
They have been tested at Oracle by running the full JDK test suite. They have also been tested at Amazon by hundreds of services in production, most of them using backports of the feature to JDK 21 and JDK 17.
Various experiments demonstrate that enabling compact object headers improves performance:
In one setting, the SPECjbb2015 benchmark uses
22% less heap space and 8% less CPU time
.
In another setting, the number of garbage collections done by SPECjbb2015 is
reduced by 15%
, with both the G1 and Parallel collectors.
A highly parallel JSON parser benchmark
runs in 10% less time
.
It is time to change compact object headers from an experimental feature to a product feature.
Description
Compact object headers are enabled in JDK 24 via the command-line options
$ java -XX:+UnlockExperimentalVMOptions -XX:+UseCompactObjectHeaders ...
The first option,
-XX:+UnlockExperimentalVMOptions
, will no longer be needed once they are a product feature.
Testing
Compact object headers were subjected to massive testing as part of
JEP 450
, in addition to the testing mentioned
above
. No further testing is required.
Some tests currently supply the
-XX:+UnlockExperimentalVMOptions
command-line option when enabling compact object headers. This will no longer be needed, so we will adjust these tests accordingly.
Risks and Assumptions
As discussed in
JEP 450
, future features may require additional object-header bits. We have already reserved four bits for
Project Valhalla
. If a need for even more bits arises then we can shrink compressed class pointers and identity hash codes even further, using techniques we have already prototyped in
Project Lilliput
.

data.title: Why does Debian change software?
data.author: tapanjk
data.article_summary:
本文解释了Debian对其打包软件进行修改的原因，主要包括以下几点：

1. **遵循政策**：软件需符合Debian政策，如配置文件位置、文档存放目录等。
2. **协同工作**：软件需相互兼容，可能需要调整执行位置或用户账户。
3. **移除“回传”代码**：出于隐私和安全考虑，移除绕过Debian打包系统进行更新的代码。
4. **修复漏洞**：在上游修复前解决漏洞，或将补丁反向移植到早期版本，特别是安全问题。
5. **法律合规**：不包含无法合法分发的部分，可能根据Debian自由软件指南移除非自由部分到“非自由”区。
6. **添加手册页**：当上游未提供时，Debian会自行添加。

感谢Jonathan McDowell的协助，文责自负。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Debian对软件代码的修改及其影响

不同观点：
• [TekMol] 支持Debian移除绕过其打包系统进行更新或“回传”的代码，认为这是保持系统稳定和安全的重要举措。
• [rmccue] 反对Debian对源代码进行修改，指出这些修改曾导致其维护的PHP库出现问题，且没有通知用户他们使用的是分支版本，也未与原开发者沟通。
• [jeroenhd] 质疑Debian对某些软件（如xscreensaver）的修改，认为这些修改可能是基于美学和个人偏好，而非技术需求。
• [galad87] 批评Debian在替换库（如FFmpeg）后未能充分测试，导致发布破损软件。
• [yoyohello13] 更倾向于使用Arch Linux，因为其依赖上游官方文档，避免了Debian修改上游代码带来的潜在问题。
• [commandersaki] 反对Debian在软件中加入自定义配置框架，认为这增加了不必要的复杂性，更倾向于保持上游的原生配置。

补充讨论：
• [lifthrasiir] 提到Debian历史上曾发生的OpenSSL私钥 entropy 问题，质疑Debian目前如何预防和缓解类似事件。
• [Affric] 询问Debian如何看待和缓解因修改软件而带来的风险。
• [JdeBP] 指出Debian在手册页处理上的问题，认为其将外部软件的手册页存于系统自己的源控制中，而非优先考虑将其贡献回上游。
• [frainfreeze] 提到Debian因法律问题移除某些软件包，并引用了相关讨论链接。
• [anthk] 提到OpenBSD也会对软件进行修改，但目的是为了安全和遵循POSIX标准。
• [hsbauauvhabzb] 询问各发行版维护者是否共享补丁、手册页、回传数据等信息，以及是否公开变更信息。
• [INTPenis] 分享其转向RHEL的经历，认为RHEL更少修改上游软件包，提供了更大的控制权，但也指出Fedora的一些政策（如默认编辑器）同样存在问题。

争议焦点：
• Debian对源代码的修改是否必要及其对软件稳定性和安全性的影响。
• 修改上游代码带来的潜在问题和额外工作量，以及与原开发者的沟通不畅。
• 不同Linux发行版在软件包处理和用户控制权上的政策差异及其优缺点。

44059411.article_content:
When I wrote
Why is Debian the way it is?
, a year and a half ago, I was asked to also cover why Debian changes the software it packages. Hereâs a brief list of examples of why that happens:
Software in Debian needs to follow certain policies as set by Debian over the years, and documented in the
Debian Policy Manual
. These are mostly mundane things like system wide configuration being in
/etc
, documentation in
/usr/share/doc
, and so on. Some of this is more intricate, like when names of executables can be the same in different packages.
Programs included in Debian need to work together in other ways. This might mean require changing one or both. As an example, they might need to agree where Unix domain socket exists, or what Unix user account they should run under.
Debian will remove code that âcalls homeâ or tries to update software in a way that bypasses the Debian packaging system. This is done both for privacy reasons, and because updating software without going via the packaging system is usually problematic from a functional point of view, and always problematic from a security point of view.
Debian may fix bugs before theyâre fixed in upstream, or may backport a bug fix to an earlier version. The goal here is to make life better for users of Debian. Debian does this especially for fixes to security problems, but also for other problems.
Debian avoids including anything in the main part of its package archive it canât legally distribute. This applies to the source packages. This means, Debian may strip out those parts software that it doesnât think are free according to the Debian Free Software Guidelines. The stripped-out parts might be moved to another package in the ânon-freeâ part of Debian. An example might a manual that is licensed under the GNU Free Documentation License with immutable parts, or a logo that canât be changed.
Debian has often added a manual page when the upstream doesnât provide one.
Thank you to Jonathan McDowell for help with this list. Opinions and mistakes are mine. Mine, I say!
44059411.article_summary:
本文解释了Debian对其打包软件进行修改的原因，主要包括以下几点：

1. **遵循政策**：软件需符合Debian政策，如配置文件位置、文档存放目录等。
2. **协同工作**：软件需相互兼容，可能需要调整执行位置或用户账户。
3. **移除“回传”代码**：出于隐私和安全考虑，移除绕过Debian打包系统进行更新的代码。
4. **修复漏洞**：在上游修复前解决漏洞，或将补丁反向移植到早期版本，特别是安全问题。
5. **法律合规**：不包含无法合法分发的部分，可能根据Debian自由软件指南移除非自由部分到“非自由”区。
6. **添加手册页**：当上游未提供时，Debian会自行添加。

感谢Jonathan McDowell的协助，文责自负。

data.title: Direct TLS can speed up your connections
data.author: tanelpoder
data.article_summary: 本文讨论了通过直接TLS加速数据库连接的方法。作者的团队发现，在使用公司VPN时，Aurora DSQL集群的连接速度很快，但不在VPN时则需要约3秒。经过调查，发现问题出在公司网络上。当客户端尝试建立TLS连接时，防火墙会尝试通过打开第二个连接来获取服务器证书，导致延迟。如果使用Postgres 17及以上版本，可以通过直接启动TLS协商来跳过额外步骤，从而加快连接速度。这解决了因防火墙规则导致的延迟问题。

How direct TLS can speed up your connections
A few months ago, one of my Aurora DSQL teammates reported a curious finding.
When connecting to their DSQL clusters using the corporate VPN, their
connections were fast and snappy - as they should be! But, when connecting
without using the VPN
, their connections were taking around 3 seconds.
Curiously, this was only happening when in the AWS offices.
Discovery
The trigger for this discovery was the public Preview of Aurora DSQL at
re:Invent 2024. Before the public release, access to DSQL had been restricted,
requiring developers to be on the corporate VPN. Developers started to interact
with DSQL off-VPN, and realized it was slower - way slower - than before.
What could possibly explain this? Clearly, it’s “the network” since that’s the
only difference. That doesn’t mean the office WiFi is slow - otherwise
connections would always be slow, instead of just off-VPN connections. But
something
about the office WiFi was adding significant overhead.
As it turns out, the office has three networks:
Both a WiFi and wired network for Amazon employees
A WiFi network for guests
One of my teammates did the following tests:
Network type
slow
Employee WiFi
yes
Employee wired
yes
Guest WiFi
no
So… there’s something specific happening
only on the corporate network
.
After doing some server-side debugging, the team noticed something strange. For
every connection being opened to the cluster, an additional connection was being
made. This second connection wasn’t even speaking Postgres!
How PostgreSQL does TLS
Reference:
Message Flow
from the Postgres 16 documentation.
To quote (with slight edits):
To initiate an SSL-encrypted connection, the frontend [Postgres client]
initially sends an SSLRequest message rather than a StartupMessage.
The server then responds with a single byte containing S or N, indicating that
it is willing or unwilling to perform SSL, respectively. The frontend might
close the connection at this point if it is dissatisfied with the response. To
continue after S, perform an SSL startup handshake (not described here, part of
the SSL specification) with the server. If this is successful, continue with
[…]
To anthropomorphize this:
client â server:
Hey, I’d like to talk to you, but first let’s setup TLS
server â client:
Sure, go ahead
client âµ server:
TLS handshake
client âµ server: [encrypted stream continues]
So, what we’re seeing in our logs is that the
first
connection does this, but
the
second
connection isn’t. The second connection was skipping ahead to step
3 and initiating a TLS handshake. Where is this second connection coming from,
and why isn’t it following protocol?
Cisco TLS Server Identity Discovery
After engaging with our corporate networking team, they shared the following
resource with us:
https://www.ciscolive.com/c/dam/r/ciscolive/us/docs/2021/pdf/BRKSEC-2106.pdf
This is awesome documentation, so if you’re into details, I’d recommend going
through it. Otherwise, here’s the summary.
The Cisco firewall has the capability to add rules based on the URL or
application being accessed. When you initiate a TLS connection, the client sends
a “hello” message to the server, and the server responds with some information
including its certificate. The firewall uses information present in the server’s
TLS certificate to enforce rules.
To really spell that out: the firewall sees the packets you’re sending and
receiving. When the client sends a
hello
, the firewall says “that looks like a
TLS hello”, and then waits for the server’s response. It inspects the
certificate and then applies any rules.
In TLS 1.3, the server’s certificate is encrypted, which means the firewall
can’t do this anymore. That’s what this slide deck is about.
TLS Server
Identity Discovery
is a feature that works around this problem. The firewall
will open a
second connection
and do a TLS 1.2 handshake to retrieve the
certificate in plaintext. If the rules allow the connection, the firewall then
allow the connection to proceed.
But, of course, that’s not what Postgres is expecting. Postgres is expecting
that clients who want to do TLS should first ask if the server supports it.
As it turns out, our firewall wasn’t configured to block unknown applications.
What was happening is the firewall
tried
to learn the certificate, then gave
up after 3s, allowing the original connection through. Mystery solved!
Direct TLS support
Here are those same Postgres docs again, this time on
version 17
. There’s new
content!
A second alternate way to initiate SSL encryption is available. The server will
recognize connections which immediately begin SSL negotiation without any
previous SSLRequest packets. Once the SSL connection is established the server
will expect a normal startup-request packet and continue negotiation over the
encrypted channel.
What this is saying is that if you’re using Postgres 17+ on both the server and

data.title: When a team is too big
data.author: gpi
data.article_summary: 文章讨论了团队规模过大时可能出现的问题，以及如何通过培养全能型人才提高生产力。作者以亲身经历为例，描述了一个14人团队在日常会议中遇到的沟通和效率问题，如信息过载、无关内容导致的分心和任务遗漏。为了解决这些问题，团队尝试了异步站会，但发现缺乏实时对话，效果不佳。随后，团队分成前端和后端两个专门小组，以提高相关性和协作效率。作者指出，全能型团队能减少内部依赖、瓶颈和单点故障，更具生产力和弹性，但全能型策略也有其局限性。文章强调了持续改进和环境准备对领导力的重要性。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：团队在日常站会（standup）中的实践与问题，包括会议时长、形式和效率的争议，以及对团队合作和角色分工的讨论。

不同观点：
• Etheryte认为站会的核心问题在于缺乏有效的主持和控制，导致会议时间过长。他主张每个人应在一分钟内完成更新，并将深入讨论延后到会后进行，强调专业环境中的纪律性。他还提到瑞典文化中的非对抗性可能加剧了这种情况。
• frollogaston分享了他们团队尝试多种站会形式（包括指定负责人和异步报告）的经验，但最终发现即时召集必要人员开短会最有效，解决了会议冗长和无关人员参与的问题。
• teeray指出站会的价值在于对话和协作，而不是单纯地汇报状态。他建议即时解决阻塞问题，而不是等待站会。
• bobek则推荐书面/异步站会，认为这种形式可以更好地解决团队沟通问题，并提供了一个详细的参考链接。
• abhaynayar的评论更偏向个人职业发展，表达了对全栈技能的兴趣以及对安全领域职业发展的担忧。
• protocolture分享了他对小团队管理的调研结果，指出小团队在沟通和管理上的优势，而大团队则可能面临沟通困难。
• agge以幽默的方式评论了团队规模与披萨的关系，并认为3-4人的团队规模在瑞典是合适的。
• pards对文章中禁止用于LLM训练的声明发表了看法，质疑其有效性和法律依据。
• makeitdouble认为全栈开发是解决团队分工过细的方案，并指出在业务执行中，全栈技能可能比纯粹的技术优化更重要。
• madaxe_again提出了团队规模扩大后出现的办公室政治问题，并建议通过任务导向的团队轮换来解决。
• FinnLobsien强调不同类型的团队（如内部支持团队和创业团队）需要不同的运作方式和人才。
• cplan将讨论与DevOps和T型工程师的概念联系起来，认为这些模式可以解决文中所提到的问题。

补充讨论：
• 对文章中禁止用于LLM训练的声明存在争议，pc86认为这种声明愚蠢且无效，公开内容不应限制其使用方式。
• 讨论中涉及了职业发展和角色转换的问题，特别是从安全领域转向全栈/DevOps的职业路径。
• 团队规模和文化背景对站会效率的影响也被多次提到，尤其是瑞典文化中的非对抗性可能导致会议时间过长。

争议焦点：
• 站会的最佳形式和时间控制方法，包括是否应采用异步报告、指定负责人或即时召集短会。
• 团队规模扩大后的管理和沟通问题，特别是办公室政治的应对策略。
• 对公开内容使用限制的声明是否有效及其法律依据。

Lately I’ve been thinking a lot about these questions:
What is a team?
How large is too large and how small is too small?
What qualifies a missions?
How to weigh the cons and pros of specialist vs generalist in the age of GenAI?
There’s a story for several years back that keeps back to my mind. What makes it interesting is the fact that there was no master plan. Yet with a few cultural elements, the story took such an interesting trajectory that it shaped my leadership model. Ever since, I have been an advocate of continuous improvement by preparing the environment instead of being the wise-ass who has the ultimate solution to all problems.
Today I want to tell that story with these key takeaways:
A generalist team is less likely to have internal dependencies acting as bottlenecks, blockage, and single point of failure. Generalist teams are more productive and resilient.
Handovers introduce the risk of misunderstanding, delay, miscommunication, and diluted accountability. Clear ownership requires knowledge, mandate, and responsibility. It’s easier to implement with generalists.
But as we’ll see generalism is not without problems either.
Subscribe
🤖🚫 Note: No generative AI was used to create this content. This page is only intended for human consumption and is NOT allowed to be used for machine training including but not limited to LLMs. (
why
?)
Story
Many yeas ago I was part of a large team. 14 members to be exact.
The problems started from the first standup: I didn't follow 90% of what everyone else was talking about. I thought it's because I'm new to the team but as time passed and I got closer to the other team members I learned that some others feel the same.
It wasn't unusual to see someone visibly yawn or fall almost sleep during the standup. There was at least something in the round of standup that was completely irrelevant and boring to a few.
In an effort to keep the standup short, we had a time limit per person paired with invented hand gestures to signal the person who is talking that their time is over.
We were 11 engineers which can still be fed on
2-pizzas
! Size wasn't the issue.
In fact, quite the opposite: every now and then we heard about a task that never came up during the standup and wasn’t in the backlog!
We learned about those phantom tasks as they were close to the finish line or after they ere delivered.
How did that happen? Usually, someone from another team or another part of the organization reached out for a friendly
favor
and since we had enough bandwidth and great engineers, they often did their best to help.
Async Standup
Later we switch to async standup. The implementation was simple: every workday a Slack reminder would pop up with a fixed message:
What did you do yesterday?
What will you do today?
Are there any impediments or do you need any help?
Each team member would write a comment more or less in line with what they would be telling at a sync (face to face) standup.
Those comments came in during the day, and some folks consistently missed it. Regardless, I rarely read all the comments because they were not relevant to what I was doing.
This was less disruptive than taking 30 minutes (less than 3 minutes per person) for the daily standup, which often dragged to 45 minutes and sometimes even an entire hour!
The async report turned to exactly that:
a report
.
The main value of a standup is to have a dialogue about blockage and spark opportunities to work together. Otherwise, it's enough to move issues on the Kanban swim lanes with a comment. That covers the reporting part. We missed a dialogue when a dialogue was due.
Concern-based Task Forces
I raised these issue in one of our retrospectives and the EM/PM said they'll take action.
The solution they came up with was to break the team into two halves:
The front-end "task force" (as it was called) would work on front-end stuff basically taking a Figma design and turning it to working UI.
The back-end task force would cover the rest from API, to CI/CD, and configuring cloud and operations.
The idea was to have smaller groups that would move faster, delivery independently, and are more relevant and connected to each other.
And we cut the team by tech, because anyone who has worked with engineers knows that they can be quite religious about their tools of choice. Back-end/Front-end seemed to be different enough to justify that cut.
The hypothesis was that front-end developers should care enough about each other's world and standup report. Similarly back-end task force should have some sort of interest and common language to hear each other and collaborate.

data.title: Hotspot: Linux `perf` GUI for performance analysis
data.author: jez
data.article_summary: Hotspot是由KDAB开发的Linux perf数据图形化分析工具，旨在为性能分析数据提供直观的用户界面，初期目标是实现类似KCachegrind的UI，围绕Linux perf工具进行可视化，并计划支持更多性能数据格式。它支持数据可视化、时间线过滤、记录数据等功能，并可通过AppImage在多种Linux发行版上运行。用户可以通过包管理器或AppImage安装Hotspot，还可以从源代码构建以获取最新版本。使用时，需先通过perf记录数据，然后用Hotspot打开生成的perf.data文件进行分析，支持命令行和图形界面操作。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：开发者对不同性能分析工具的评价和使用体验

不同观点：
• [gue-ni] 提到 Firefox 也支持加载 'perf' 报告，并提供了相关链接。该评论主要是分享额外的一个工具，没有过多评价。
• [ognarb] 推荐了 Heaptrack 工具用于调查内存使用情况，并提供了相关链接，认为该工具对内存分析非常有帮助。
• [directmusic] 主要从事 macOS 开发，使用 Instruments 进行性能分析，但在 Linux 上更常用 Hotspot，并对其表示高度推荐。
• [fransje26] 对 Hotspot 工具给予高度评价，认为其易于使用，并与 perf 工具配合良好，尤其提到在 QtCreator 中的无缝集成体验。
• [dustbunny] 表示对 Hotspot 使用上有些困惑，转而使用了 speedscope，并考虑重新尝试 Hotspot。
• [drewg123] 询问 Hotspot 是否具有类似 Vtune 的源代码视图功能，能够将周期/缓存未命中等归因于代码行。
• [wizzledonker] 强烈推荐 Hotspot，表示每天都在使用以解决代码瓶颈问题。
• [grandinj] 认为 Hotspot 是非常有用的工具，对其在优化 LibreOffice 中的贡献表示赞赏。
• [pjmlp] 简单表示对工具的赞赏和感谢。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点：部分用户如 [dustbunny] 对 Hotspot 的使用感到困惑，转而使用其他工具如 speedscope，但其他用户如 [directmusic]、[fransje26] 和 [wizzledonker] 则对 Hotspot 给予高度评价。
• 功能讨论：[drewg123] 关注 Hotspot 是否具有类似 Vtune 的源代码视图功能，这表明不同用户对工具功能的需求和期望有所不同。
• 工具集成：[fransje26] 提到 Hotspot 与 QtCreator 的无缝集成，这是一个值得注意的优点，提升了工具的使用体验。

总体来看，评论中对 Hotspot 的评价大多积极，但也有用户对使用上存在一定困惑，并提到了其他替代工具。
